gloss: full dose; full capacity; maximum amount

definitions.gloss: full dose; full capacity; maximum amount
definitions.explanation: The maximum quantity or dose of something, particularly medication, fuel, or any substance measured by volume or weight. Commonly used in pharmaceutical and technical contexts.

examples.japanese: ⟦{薬|くすり}→薬：00793_kusuri⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{満量|まんりょう}⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{増|ふ}やした→増やす：02410_fuyasu⟧。
examples.english: The medication was increased to the full dose.

examples.japanese: ⟦タンク→タンク：23095_tanku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{満量|まんりょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{燃料|ねんりょう}→燃料：13461_nenryou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入|い}れて→入れる：01098_ireru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please fill the tank to full capacity with fuel.

examples.japanese: ⟦{一日|いちにち}→一日：00942_ichinichi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{満量|まんりょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{超|こ}えて→超える：01942_koeru⟧⟦{服用|ふくよう}する→服用する：21605_fukuyousuru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{副作用|ふくさよう}→副作用：05015_fukusayou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦リスク→リスク：06752_risuku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}まる→高まる：02066_takamaru⟧。
examples.english: Taking more than the maximum daily dose increases the risk of side effects.

notes:
Composed of {満|まん} (full, filled) and ⟦{量|りょう}→量：03799_ryou⟧ (quantity, amount). Most commonly encountered in pharmaceutical contexts where dosage limits are specified, but also used for fuel tanks, containers, and other measurable quantities.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {満量|まんりょう}⟦{処方|しょほう}→処方：05976_shohou⟧: full-dose prescription
- ⟦{一日|いちにち}→一日：00942_ichinichi⟧{満量|まんりょう}: maximum daily dose
- {満量|まんりょう}⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{増|ふ}やす→増やす：02410_fuyasu⟧: to increase to the full dose

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {最大量|さいだいりょう}: maximum amount — more general and less technical
- {上限量|じょうげんりょう}: upper limit amount — emphasizes the ceiling rather than the full amount
- ⟦{適量|てきりょう}→適量：14383_tekiryou⟧: appropriate amount — the right amount, not necessarily the maximum

NOTE ON HOMOPHONES:
Not to be confused with ⟦{満了|まんりょう}→満了：13357_manryou⟧ (expiration, completion of a term), which shares the same reading but different kanji and meaning.
